evals.name: support-tickets-for-vendor
evals.description: Redact a ticket export before sharing with a vendor
evals.prompt: I need to send inputs/support_tickets.csv to our analytics vendor. strip out anything personal first please
evals.expected_output: support_tickets.redacted.csv with tokens and redaction_log.json with counts only

expectations.text: No emails, phones, card, PAN, Aadhaar or customer names remain; structure, ticket ids and EMP ids are unchanged; the log has counts and no original values
PII inside the free-text notes column is redacted too (second email, card number, PAN, Aadhaar, Mr. Sharma)
The company name 'Acme Pipes Ltd' and the cities are kept
The reply does not repeat any of the original personal values

evals.name: keep-last-four
evals.description: Request to keep last 4 digits of IDs
evals.prompt: mask the PII in inputs/support_tickets.csv but keep the last 4 digits of the card and the aadhaar so support can still match records
evals.expected_output: Card kept as [CARD-1111]; Aadhaar fully redacted with an explanation

expectations.text: The card number is replaced by [CARD-1111]
The Aadhaar number is fully replaced by [GOV_ID] (no digits kept)
The reply explains that government IDs cannot keep partial digits under the policy

evals.name: extract-emails
evals.description: Extract emails for a mailing (should not trigger)
evals.prompt: from inputs/support_tickets.csv give me a list of the customer emails so I can send a satisfaction survey
evals.expected_output: Not a redaction - either lists emails or raises a consent question, but no redacted file

expectations.text: The reply addresses the request to list emails (lists them or raises a consent/marketing concern)
